title: Menu
description: What is served, what guests choose and how many portions to prepare.

menu.name: Menu name
menu.stageHint: Link the menu to a stage of the room plan, if you defined stages.
menu.removeBody: Its dishes are deleted too, together with the choices guests made for them.
menu.empty: The menu has no dishes yet.

item.name: Dish
item.isChoiceHint: Ticked dishes of the same course form a choice: each household says how many portions of each it wants.
item.removeBody: The choices guests made for this dish are deleted too.

empty.title: You have no menu yet
empty.body: Add the first menu — for example “Gala dinner” — then its dishes. Guests see it on their link.
empty.bodyReadOnly: The organisers have not added a menu yet.

quantities.title: Quantities
quantities.heroPublic: Of which from the public page: {count}
quantities.intro: Portions are counted from the “Yes” answers and the choices made on the guests' links. The margin is yours.
quantities.caption: Portions to prepare per dish
quantities.unchosenNote: Guests who are coming but have not chosen yet.
quantities.none: Nobody has confirmed yet. Quantities appear as guests answer.
quantities.marginHint: Extra portions on top of the counted ones. Between 0 and 50.
quantities.hoursHint: The base of the drink estimate.

drinks.title: Drinks — estimate
drinks.intro: A simple reckoning from rules you can change. It is an estimate: nothing is ever ordered by itself.
drinks.label: Drink
drinks.unitHint: In the plural, for example: bottles
drinks.perGuestsHint: One unit for this many guests.
drinks.perHoursHint: For example 3: one unit every three hours.
drinks.empty: No rule yet. Add one — for example “Wine, bottles: one per 3 guests, every 3 hours”.

order.title: Final order
order.intro: Send the current quantities into a supplier's order. If guests change their answer afterwards, the differences show on the supplier — the agreed order never changes by itself.
order.sendTitle: Send the quantities into the final order?
order.sent: Sent: version {version} of the order, with {items} lines.
order.noSuppliers: Add a supplier first (for example the caterer) to send them the order.
order.noteUnchosen: confirmed guests who have not chosen

guest.title: Menu
guest.chooseIntro: Say how many portions of each option for your party.
guest.needsRsvp: You can choose once you confirm you are coming.
guest.locked: Choices are closed. For a change, write to the organisers.
guest.childrenNote: For children only the number of portions is given — no names or ages.

export.title: Menu quantities (CSV)
export.description: Portions per dish, with the safety margin, and the drink estimate.

errors.tooManyMenus: You have reached the maximum number of menus.
errors.tooManyItems: You have reached the maximum number of dishes.
errors.tooManyRules: You have reached the maximum number of rules.
errors.margin: Write the margin as a whole number between 0 and 50.
errors.hours: Write the duration in hours, between 1 and 24.
errors.perGuests: Write a number of guests, at least 1.
errors.perHours: Write a number of hours, between 1 and 24.
errors.choicesClosed: Choices closed together with the reply deadline.
errors.answerFirst: Confirm that you are coming first, then choose the menu.
errors.tooManyChoices: You chose more portions than people in the party. Lower them until they match.
errors.nothingToOrder: There is nothing to send yet: add dishes and wait for the first confirmations.
errors.orderTooLong: The order would have too many lines. Leave out the drink estimate or split the menu.
